definitions.explanation: Large bodies of salt water; the world's oceans. More formal and scientific than {海|うみ}.

notes:
{海洋|かいよう} is the sea as a scientific and administrative subject — the domain studied, polluted, regulated, and drawn on for resources. For the sea you swim in or look at, the word is ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧.
